   77: The under-constraint is in the initial condition. $\mu_{\text{eff}}(t_{\text{Planck}}) \gg \lambda_{\min}$ is an order-of-magnitude estimate. The BCS phase diagram $\Delta(\tau, \mu)$ will be insensitive to the precise initial $\mu$ (because $\mu \gg \lambda_{\min}$ is deep in the condensed phase), but the locking dynamics -- whether $\Delta$ locks $\tau$ before $\mu$ drops below $\lambda_{\min}$ -- will depend on the cooling rate $H(t)$, which depends on the full cosmological model. This is a one-parameter family of solutions, not a zero-parameter prediction.
